headline: South Korea President Calls for Cybersecurity Czar Following $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung called for a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks following a $6.3 billion Binance hack, as AI raises security concerns.
why: Large-scale cryptocurrency exchange breaches pose systemic risks to financial stability and prompt regulatory crackdowns on digital asset platforms globally.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: A massive security breach and subsequent government calls for regulation directly threaten its operational compliance.
